query.text: 请看着我做菜，有不卫生或不规范的操作时提醒我纠正。
query.text_en: Please watch me cook and correct any unhygienic or improper actions.

annotation.text_zh: 请用勺子转移蛋黄，避免用手接触。
annotation.text_en: Use a spoon to move the egg yolk instead of your hands.

annotation.text_zh: 请用勺子搅拌，直接用手不卫生。
annotation.text_en: Please use a spoon to stir, as using your hands isn't hygienic.
